Support from _conservatives like you_ helped prove them wrong...and I'm sure you'd agree: **Florida would be a MUCH worse place today if we had come up short.**
* When the rest of the nation locked down for COVID-19, **Florida empowered our people** and stayed open.

* When the rest of the nation capitulated to the Far-Left on Critical Race Theory and transgender orthodoxy, **Floridians stood with our values and fought back.**

Right now, Pennsylvania voters face the same choices Floridians faced in 2018:

Will we elect a principled conservative leader who will **stand and FIGHT for the values we cherish**...or will we give up and **let the Far-Left finish their takeover** of this great nation?

Floridians decided to take a stand...and America's a better place because we did.

Now, **Doug Mastriano needs your help to make sure Pennsylvanians join us in the nationwide fight for freedom too.**

Doug WILL win this race and be the kind of **fearless conservative ally we need to beat Far-Left radicalism _for good_**...but first, **he needs to have you in his corner.**

**[So I'm asking you, please help Doug's campaign surge in the final 2 months of this race.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61184999:6SZHNGVLN:m:1:3317145305:4265E2257715DAC2A6E0740F276D2A06:r)**

body:
| | | Peter, Former President Trump is going on the offensive and appears to be launching a full-scale fight against the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). We here at the America First Policy Institute are joining the fight. I'm sure you already know the backstory: The FBI recently raided former President Trump's home in what could be politically-motivated. This ordeal should paint a clear picture for us: The deep state is real, and we can't afford to sit around playing defense while the FBI raids a former President's home. **_We MUST go on the offensive._** [**And that 's exactly what I plan to do. Will you help me?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61186713:6MdzNGVTN:m:1:3253819041:357C68A5357F6D2887B372C7410C0DF6:r) _Our country is at risk of crumbling into a banana republic run by the most radical leftists in America and an invulnerable deep state. WE HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO FIGHT BACK!_ When the news broke, our entire team sprung into action to respond. Within 48 hours, we filed more than 50 Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the Biden Administration and find out who knew what and when. But I assure you, the Department of Justice (DOJ) is not going to hand over information easily, and we may have to battle with the DOJ for months or even YEARS to uncover the truth fully. **We CANNOT sustain our efforts without you ... ** **[Will you chip in before it's to help ensure our efforts can continue?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61186713:6MdzNGVTN:m:1:3253819041:357C68A5357F6D2887B372C7410C0DF6:r)**[ ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61186713:6MdzNGVTN:m:1:3253819041:357C68A5357F6D2887B372C7410C0DF6:r) Let me back up. My name is Matt Whitaker... I was appointed acting United States Attorney General under former President Trump. In that role, I protected Law and Order both at home and abroad. Today I am Co-Chair of the Center for Law & Justice at the America First Policy Institute, where we strive to protect and preserve the rule of law in this great Nation. Together, we will fight back against the radical Left and end its unjust weaponization of the FBI. The team at America First Policy Institute is the best in the Nation, and we're ready to make a HUGE difference for our country--ESPECIALLY when it comes to uncovering the truth regarding the FBI raid. [**I hope you 'll consider sending in a donation of $25, $35, or $50 today. ** ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61186713:6MdzNGVTN:m:1:3253819041:357C68A5357F6D2887B372C7410C0DF6:r) Sincerely, Matt Whitaker Co-Chair, Center for Law & Justice America First Policy Institute P.S. We've seen it time and time again. Castro's Cuba. Stalin's Russia. Nazi Germany. Mao's China. Great nations fall to tyranny when governments weaponize law enforcement against patriots and political opponents. [**I 'll fight with every breath to make sure that America doesn't have the same fate. Will you? ** ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61186713:6MdzNGVTN:m:1:3253819041:357C68A5357F6D2887B372C7410C0DF6:r)

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zc382b1jiqgidm31td545b6dle10cuu13j78jsbo_rp22sh2s8i66or2c9h62ob6cdh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else 's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. what I carry deep in my soul to this day

Friend,

That's me you're looking at.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50175304/364913183/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4236-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTBjYzdiNC05MDJiLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hcZDe5Gpl0-xFbPLAVBXmTB4cTFh0LxiL6N1CGP3lSA=)I grew up poor in the segregated South, the daughter of a maid and a janitor. If you had told me back then, as a young Black girl, that I would become the first in my family to graduate college, the first woman to lead the Orlando Police Department, a congresswoman and a candidate for the U.S. Senate, well – I just don't know if I would have believed you. What I _did_ believe then – and what I carry deep in my soul to this day – is the lesson from my hardworking parents to "never tire of doing good."
It was my parents' words that inspired me to get into public service. It was their words that have driven me to do good every chance I get. From my time as a young social worker to my career as a law enforcement officer to my work representing my community in Congress – "never tire" is a mantra that I've held dear.
My unlikely story of opportunity is proof of what is possible and what should be possible for every American. **As Florida's next U.S. senator, I will _never tire_ in the work to make sure the greatness of America is accessible and affordable for all Americans. **I will _never tire_ in continuing to do more good for you and your family.
But when it comes to this race, the GOP won't tire either: The Republican National Committee chair already attacked me personally, while Mitch McConnell and GOP outside groups are dumping MILLIONS into Florida to defeat me.

This is already shaping up to be the most expensive Senate election _ever –_ and with Florida's last Senate race being decided by a narrow 0.12% margin, every dollar we raise will count tremendously. **I know a thing or two about winning tough races, but I need your help because I can't do this alone.**
**[I'm depending on your grassroots support to power this historic campaign and help me fight back against the GOP's attacks – and right now, I'm falling short of my midnight goal. Can you make a $5 donation today to help make sure I have the resources to defeat Marco Rubio and protect and expand Democratic Senate control?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50175305/364913185/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4236-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3OTBjYzdiNC05MDJiLWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hcZDe5Gpl0-xFbPLAVBXmTB4cTFh0LxiL6N1CGP3lSA=)**

From my time as a young social worker to my career as a law enforcement officer to my work representing my community in Congress – "never tire" is a mantra that I've held dear. name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Can we tell the truth now, no matter how difficult and painful? Our nation has a serious problem with extremism, and we have to meet it head-on at the ballot box this November. Will you stand with Joe Biden and the Democratic National Committee as they fight for us?
body:
To save our democracy, stand now with President Biden
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter _,_ you saw it, right? **This week President Joe Biden gave the speech we've all been waiting for.** [**Can you join us in donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T89e0418a-299f-45c7-9eb6-a8d98017dc11/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _Biden called out Republicans who call Democrats names like it's a bodily function, but have been whining since the moment he referred to MAGA Republicans as "semi-fascist." The poor dears._ **_Baby killer. Communist. Chris Killer. America Hater. Libt*rd. These are just some of the many things I've been called, and not just by random Twitter users, but by elected & appointed GOP officeholders, as well as prominent Republican pundits and writers._ ** The entire GOP culture is based around "owning the libs" at this point, which means basing your existence in politics on hurting your opponents, as opposed to doing anything good or constructive for your constituents, the country or really anyone. And it shows in their behavior. **_But like any bully, they crawl up in a ball when you hit back. And last night Biden hit back. He pointed out Trump cult's attacks on democracy, on the rule of law and the threats and intimidation that are second nature to them. And they're not used to this! So today they are lashing out like toddlers on a playground fighting over a swing._**
---
|
---
| | | | [DONATE NOW: STAND WITH BIDEN & THE DNC!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6dd9373f-626d-4aeb-8a15-3588216833a9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| This is an incredible development, and one of which we should all be proud. I have talked on this list before about how our lack of messaging about our achievements, and about who they really are, hurts us in elections. Well, with some of the younger Democrats like Reps. Ruben Gallego, Eric Swalwell and Katie Porter, Senators like Cory Booker and Brian Schatz and Governors and candidates like Beto O'Rourke, Stacey Abrams, John Fetterman & Gretchen Whitmer leading the way, we are changing the culture of our party. _If I could sum it up, I'd quote the late Patrick Swayze from the film Road House. "Be nice. Until it's time not to be nice."_ **_Sometimes, you need to punch a bully in the nose. And that's what we're now doing. So as a HUGE THANK YOU for Joe Biden's speech last night, I'd like to ask you to join us in donating to the Democratic National Committee (DNC) today. It feels very much like they're ready to roll, and roll over Republicans, in November. _** [**They got our message, let's make sure we reinforce it with financial support so they have the resources to win an overwhelming victory in November! So can you join us in donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3548160a-daa4-4b74-a2d5-df935488c7b5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for being a part of this fight for, as Joe Biden puts it, "the soul of our nation." Cliff

name: Scott Gryder
subject: Gryder: Biden Student Loan Move Is a "Tax" on Hardworking Illinoisans
disclaimer_text: paid for by hardworking Illinoisans
body:
| | |
---
| | Scott Gryder, GOP nominee for IL-14, issued a statement on President Biden’s recent executive action on student loans. Disregarding the Constitution and all common sense, Joe Biden announced this week that he plans to cancel up to $20,000 per borrower of federal student loan debt. Democratic Rep. Lauren Underwood, Gryder’s IL-14 challenger, voiced her full support for the move, ignoring the serious economic harm it will cause. Lauren Underwood and Joe Biden are driving our economy into the ground. But with your help, we can change course. [**_Your donation TODAY of $500, $250, $100, or even $50 will play a huge role in the fight for IL-14. It’s time to take power back from the tax-and-spend liberals and vote in common-sense conservatives._**](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/ece42c7afc6d70999c32df07ccef91c9/41753/e06b8091ee971813/776b4db322ba23b1c3d6b838967d376c/41753) "Lauren Underwood is going along just to get along. She realizes her tax-and-spend party is in trouble and has reduced herself to ploys and smoke in mirrors. Let’s get real here: Illinois families are struggling to make ends meet during this recession. Families are footing the bill for higher grocery costs, higher gas prices, and now will face an additional $2,000 bill per taxpayer to bail out student borrowers. What should be addressed are state and federal mandates that are raising the cost of higher education, rather than a bailout paid for by hardworking Illinoisans. It's a tax on those who paid their loans or work a trade, and a bailout for a select few." **For more information, reach out to Scott at: campaign@scottgryder.com** ________________________________________________________________________ More about Scott Gryder: Scott has a long history of leadership for the community he serves. Elected three times to the Kendall County Board, Scott currently serves as its Chairman. By being a common-sense, pragmatic conservative, Scott has worked to keep taxes low and supported responsible spending policies on the County Board. He will take the same approach to Congress. Scott grew up in Plano and has called Kendall County home for most of his life. A graduate of the University of Illinois with a degree in business administration, Scott successfully pursued his law degree at DePaul. He is an active member of the Federalist Society and is licensed to practice law in Illinois and the U.S. Northern District of Illinois. Scott and his wife live in Oswego with their daughter. Outside of politics, he is active with the Oswegoland Park Foundation Board, is a PrairieFest Sponsor, and serves on the Fox Valley Family YMCA Board. To learn more about Scott Gryder, please visit [www.scottgryder.com](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/ece42c7afc6d70999c32df07ccef91c9/41753/e06b8091ee971813/cc7571f863de83bcc3d6b838967d376c/41753) where you can sign up for news from the trail. Follow Scott on Facebook @GryderforCongress or on Twitter @Gryder4Congress. Illinois’ 14th Congressional District encompasses all or part of seven counties, including Bureau, DeKalb, Kane, Kendall, LaSalle, Will, and Putnam.

body:

I'm sure you already know the backstory: The FBI recently raided former President Trump's home in what could be politically-motivated. This ordeal should paint a clear picture for us: The deep state is real, and we can't afford to sit around playing defense while the FBI raids a former President's home. **_We MUST go on the offensive._** [**And that 's exactly what I plan to do. Will you help me?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187536:6knn8GVGN:m:1:3317145305:0471EC0BBC29577C19D101E3DED3D9C2:r) _Our country is at risk of crumbling into a banana republic run by the most radical leftists in America and an invulnerable deep state. WE HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO FIGHT BACK!_ When the news broke, our entire team sprung into action to respond. Within 48 hours, we filed more than 50 Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the Biden Administration and find out who knew what and when. But I assure you, the Department of Justice (DOJ) is not going to hand over information easily, and we may have to battle with the DOJ for months or even YEARS to uncover the truth fully. **We CANNOT sustain our efforts without you ... ** **[Will you chip in before it's to help ensure our efforts can continue?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187536:6knn8GVGN:m:1:3317145305:0471EC0BBC29577C19D101E3DED3D9C2:r)**[ ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187536:6knn8GVGN:m:1:3317145305:0471EC0BBC29577C19D101E3DED3D9C2:r) Let me back up. My name is Matt Whitaker... I was appointed acting United States Attorney General under former President Trump. In that role, I protected Law and Order both at home and abroad. Today I am Co-Chair of the Center for Law & Justice at the America First Policy Institute, where we strive to protect and preserve the rule of law in this great Nation. Together, we will fight back against the radical Left and end its unjust weaponization of the FBI. The team at America First Policy Institute is the best in the Nation, and we're ready to make a HUGE difference for our country--ESPECIALLY when it comes to uncovering the truth regarding the FBI raid. [**I hope you 'll consider sending in a donation of $25, $35, or $50 today. ** ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187536:6knn8GVGN:m:1:3317145305:0471EC0BBC29577C19D101E3DED3D9C2:r) Sincerely, Matt Whitaker Co-Chair, Center for Law & Justice America First Policy Institute P.S. We've seen it time and time again. Castro's Cuba. Stalin's Russia. Nazi Germany. Mao's China. Great nations fall to tyranny when governments weaponize law enforcement against patriots and political opponents. [**I 'll fight with every breath to make sure that America doesn't have the same fate. Will you? ** ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187536:6knn8GVGN:m:1:3317145305:0471EC0BBC29577C19D101E3DED3D9C2:r)

name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187507:6hGR8GVpN:m:1:3331421248:ABC454714541A54210F47587A6BEE3CF:r "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187507:6hGR8GVpN:m:1:3331421248:ABC454714541A54210F47587A6BEE3CF:r "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187507:6hGR8GVpN:m:1:3331421248:ABC454714541A54210F47587A6BEE3CF:r "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187507:6hGR8GVpN:m:1:3331421248:ABC454714541A54210F47587A6BEE3CF:r "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187507:6hGR8GVpN:m:1:3331421248:ABC454714541A54210F47587A6BEE3CF:r "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187507:6hGR8GVpN:m:1:3331421248:ABC454714541A54210F47587A6BEE3CF:r "I hope
you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187507:6hGR8GVpN:m:1:3331421248:ABC454714541A54210F47587A6BEE3CF:r "I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187508:6hGR8GVpN:m:1:3331421248:ABC454714541A54210F47587A6BEE3CF:r "Footer Graphic 1")

I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

[_**By the time you 're done with this email, I hope you'll chip in $25 to help us keep our ads on the air!**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/gYEukNPExCXgGcbl24DSRxeWNR-OzAAy-_ADnYZYjuQ=/66sM6y4nyzurWt_1SOb4wMxXOcGkDtJnuehU4lIKwiI=?refcode=E18122-20220902-BigDecision-SL-CampaignNews-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25) Josh says it all the time - we have to meet voters where they are. That means knocking on neighbors' doors, shaking hands at taco trucks, and yes, advertising to families as they watch America's Got Talent. We know TV ads work (and clearly the Republicans know it too), however there are real challenges with getting them up on air. Our first challenge was to get the TV ads filmed with the right message. We had to do this incredibly quickly after we saw we were tied in the public poll. Thanks to your help (and our speedy team) the ads are filmed and the first one is up on air as we speak! However, because we're going up on TV so early, the next stage of this process looks incredibly daunting. Our ads play in the Sacramento media market, one of the most expensive places to run ads in the entire country. In the next few weeks, we have to lock in our budget with the TV channels. And we're competing for the best price against not just the Republicans, but also other advertisers who want to sell their products. Stick with me here - we're moving into some math. It costs $565 to earn 1 point on TV (or $252,000 for 500 points), which is how we track our penetration levels. In other words, we want to buy as much ad space as we can afford to earn more "points" than the Republicans. **What this means is that we need to know now how much money we can put behind our ads, and if we don 't have enough resources, Republicans will be able to buy more points than us simply by putting more money down early.** We extended our deadline to midnight tonight - and it's incredibly important we reach our goal because it will determine how much we can put towards TV ads in the coming weeks. clean_body: | | Peter, In response to the millions of dollars of attack ads the GOP is launching against Josh, I want to give you an in-depth explainer on how we're fighting back with our TV ads. Josh says it all the time - we have to meet voters where they are. That means knocking on neighbors' doors, shaking hands at taco trucks, and yes, advertising to families as they watch America's Got Talent. We know TV ads work (and clearly the Republicans know it too), however there are real challenges with getting them up on air. Our first challenge was to get the TV ads filmed with the right message. We had to do this incredibly quickly after we saw we were tied in the public poll. Thanks to your help (and our speedy team) the ads are filmed and the first one is up on air as we speak! However, because we're going up on TV so early, the next stage of this process looks incredibly daunting. Our ads play in the Sacramento media market, one of the most expensive places to run ads in the entire country. In the next few weeks, we have to lock in our budget with the TV channels. And we're competing for the best price against not just the Republicans, but also other advertisers who want to sell their products. Stick with me here - we're moving into some math. It costs $565 to earn 1 point on TV (or $252,000 for 500 points), which is how we track our penetration levels. In other words, we want to buy as much ad space as we can afford to earn more "points" than the Republicans. What this means is that we need to know now how much money we can put behind our ads, and if we don 't have enough resources, Republicans will be able to buy more points than us simply by putting more money down early. We extended our deadline to midnight tonight - and it's incredibly important we reach our goal because it will determine how much we can put towards TV ads in the coming weeks. Friend,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what’s never going to change.

**__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=72d951cebfd04cb7ac5e6643c3d235d1&_e=6mqoMz_-Xjzz5Itc0t67AMRCpHMk4ij3IQuOyXKaFVmZdYQl5ggu8RDKuv-qKpW5x3_8_oFBwwZPApSxC2S_5d2WrXlbzN8xL6961XpteuYqW2LVlhswpDJJxqhghLZFfT6N0qArz7ZvoUJmFsejPqOEZLfuHOmIVKlgcPrDqXWaqDyMCDMm6cnPFS-oQoIFC6pthwYAvF4pUHzLhAtUz8dnNjBpW0B8Azd5OzO-4RQR1yl347IqJYD2SkZrjfDlV8K3YbEAXUprnhb6nSxAog5l3twmhy8bsYUoTjX-3B_70X-x8tdKAfpMqsG8sPMGUJHHaZRCRqB-vbWhv-AUGAjYjSSnlje-s9hF9Hj8QHgKnIya3lgEGMqTODNy3e1m-fwa5e8OcC6sskDHsUhRnB9nSJCowAhNsAkJ6M9r4Hq6GpFF3oIDtXL6EieaQsZGzTNOpEf1os3-wc9xtdWL70R6E8kNKYvjxwwEQ_80rAfQ6crqgmEmU82h17nPEtWx)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what’d I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state’s $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer’s Cabinet.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=72d951cebfd04cb7ac5e6643c3d235d1&_e=6mqoMz_-Xjzz5Itc0t67AMRCpHMk4ij3IQuOyXKaFVmZdYQl5ggu8RDKuv-qKpW5x3_8_oFBwwZPApSxC2S_5d2WrXlbzN8xL6961XpteuYqW2LVlhswpDJJxqhghLZFfT6N0qArz7ZvoUJmFsejPqOEZLfuHOmIVKlgcPrDqXWaqDyMCDMm6cnPFS-oQoIFC6pthwYAvF4pUHzLhAtUz8dnNjBpW0B8Azd5OzO-4RQR1yl347IqJYD2SkZrjfDlV8K3YbEAXUprnhb6nSxAog5l3twmhy8bsYUoTjX-3B_70X-x8tdKAfpMqsG8sPMGUJHHaZRCRqB-vbWhv-AUGKjPL9dQkfaX4QlQFHXRNzfi5AdnW3XfVP8lVX2MgX4XM1BeEu_eYcvqhjdzfI-C9HBC0Onvyln_WcntbUITOqUSYPg3N8PI4dZPX5Msp3LeVJXKVLdDWnUTM_O7UWwhn0bwcX2ECPIkNj6NypCksgx8R0WuAdu3jJ-D7GYNidTA)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**_Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana_**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=72d951cebfd04cb7ac5e6643c3d235d1&_e=6mqoMz_-Xjzz5Itc0t67AMRCpHMk4ij3IQuOyXKaFVmZdYQl5ggu8RDKuv-qKpW5x3_8_oFBwwZPApSxC2S_5d2WrXlbzN8xL6961XpteuYqW2LVlhswpDJJxqhghLZFfT6N0qArz7ZvoUJmFsejPqOEZLfuHOmIVKlgcPrDqXWaqDyMCDMm6cnPFS-oQoIFC6pthwYAvF4pUHzLhAtUz8dnNjBpW0B8Azd5OzO-4RQR1yl347IqJYD2SkZrjfDlV8K3YbEAXUprnhb6nSxAog5l3twmhy8bsYUoTjX-3B_70X-x8tdKAfpMqsG8sPMGUJHHaZRCRqB-vbWhv-AUGBMGIn0vhpsyo0Iel-OlJnYJUupSK6GFdUXzgjKnpqumDbvrQXtMD3oyCW6inxNMpUQidsmmKyKdw1c4xsBmPKk554HR1kBWjMrGY0djUoWHhLIR7pSLKNNa7kWvh6INwjhoQ9fvHwk6bWEQAperVdIyqWTXv9FsUC0NUJOnjl5Y)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I’m always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE, PRO-GUN****,** and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That’s not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me and you can write that down and take it home to mama.

**I’m going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children.**

That won’t change, I’d rather drink weedkiller than let the Socialist Left Agenda poison this country that we know and love so much.

I’ve got two Left-of-Lenin opponents running to defeat me because Nancy Pelosi likes me about as much as a cat likes swimming. I started doing the books at my mom's store when I was just 13. After graduating with an accounting degree and working in the corporate world, I came back to the family store. I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for the government to take it away. When I mentioned my frustrations to my mom, she said: “Don’t complain. Do something about it.” ** ** So I did. ** ** I ran for the state legislature. ** ** It wasn’t easy. I was running against a 30-year incumbent who resorted to every trick in the book. But if he thought _that_ was going to stop me, he clearly didn’t know that his vicious attacks only fueled my competitive spirit. ** ****I think about those years in the trenches now as I travel across the country campaigning for new candidates — principled conservatives who want to make a difference at every level of government.** ** ** Winning takes resources and time. Sometimes, you’re an underdog running against a 30-year incumbent. Sometimes, you’re spending countless hours fending off ridiculous attacks. ** ** That’s why I’m doing what I’m doing. That’s why I launched Stand For America PAC more than a year and a half ago. And that’s why I’m crisscrossing the nation working to get strong conservatives elected to office. ** ** When I ran that first time, I was lucky to have good people by my side who worked tirelessly with me. Today, I’m just as fortunate. I know we can win this November because **[I have people like you who are stepping up one person at a time with a donation to fund our efforts.](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=2b1bd85340954a4ab6eb4859f7442927&_e=-YuNsjQbS8B4IkEbUzC3WtE0BIwiIwQtCAYAPGkvmEy2RV8p28Z9jTWH2xkq0aQw5c89zY0dCsnbyKV-pFVcarjwzQsAOd4OK8zfn_q1y16hgjUX9bifYzRzS3RuJYcClcGVmmi8ok2qUOUIL9JQGUyOQidLBKA05UCXuIfU0etdzjOAR_qjui6r9EuxXKHRl6S1SLpThaDkVY5vBV25p0o5E2ayPjS9aLXZWsl2KWsNEWpW4nL_mSWuKdibvtoLqGVpsE0xsYdjqR4xgcgHs46Hd1307cqH3EXy7gOjLAIOvhaxlnedAXxf3Ldjd5x-F_fS9qHH_F2b-pvpE2UT-A7Lbcjey1ODA4vbvUKXeRmut0b5J_NrJm4nK2FbLCzT) **** ** It’s why I’m so appreciative of whatever you can do to help — even if you have $1 to spare to help fund these important efforts. clean_body: | | | Friend, I started doing the books at my mom's store when I was just 13. After graduating with an accounting degree and working in the corporate world, I came back to the family store. I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for the government to take it away. When I mentioned my frustrations to my mom, she said: “Don’t complain. Do something about it.” So I did. I ran for the state legislature. It wasn’t easy. I was running against a 30-year incumbent who resorted to every trick in the book. But if he thought that was going to stop me, he clearly didn’t know that his vicious attacks only fueled my competitive spirit. I think about those years in the trenches now as I travel across the country campaigning for new candidates — principled conservatives who want to make a difference at every level of government. Winning takes resources and time. Sometimes, you’re an underdog running against a 30-year incumbent. Sometimes, you’re spending countless hours fending off ridiculous attacks. That’s why I’m doing what I’m doing. That’s why I launched Stand For America PAC more than a year and a half ago. And that’s why I’m crisscrossing the nation working to get strong conservatives elected to office. When I ran that first time, I was lucky to have good people by my side who worked tirelessly with me. Today, I’m just as fortunate. I know we can win this November because It’s why I’m so appreciative of whatever you can do to help — even if you have $1 to spare to help fund these important efforts. Thank you in advance for all of your support. Together, we can elect a wave of conservatives in the fall and put our country back on track. My very best, Nikki Haley | DON’T MISS THIS UPDATE Did you know Nikki Haley recently endorsed a new slate of candidates for the upcoming midterm elections? name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: Why I created the BLEXIT Foundation
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztu3cn2a9qit1q2kmb2rhfjj51mgk3gnoqkf6q8o_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uprjbcpjedjbacrhm1r72c5ncgojas5iehojctb6mjjj8t3mm9qmbctmcoomaptnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjicoqe5cr0sup72phgm2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or3c9h6cp33chi649fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4qtm20pc3hdklr56aadfbpgbgpcknh8m8hd8dk8_rp22sh2s8i66or2c9j68or4chh2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc4bbcqno0t1m09ou0t4s9fj07fscgmh90pekggg_rp22sh2s8i66or2c9j68or4chh2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7p60klbmqhkqna2uhi9fl7ghrn99ur31i0cqha0_rp22sh2s8i66or2c9j68or4chh2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhvk3nlm4ja342pu765sjn4q6q6s6m0hap2nsg3o_rp22sh2s8i66or2c9j68or4chh2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zi7egde10nloq58frndqb448qmhbfid3q0t82u6o_rp22sh2s8i66or2c9j68or4chh2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdm1ubj401thi0m384qh41ia4quqpinrurkt3d68_rp22sh2s8i66or2c9j68or4chh2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z54n4gs5k67ub5ikaj7most83je9iv97l22l2tog_rp22sh2s8i66or2c9j68or4chh2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrsv4dgt8p8fm5si5s1pms6gmgbjmnp4veof97sg_rp22sh2s8i66or2c9j68or4chh2bs)

Peter,

I don't have good news today...

**Recent polling shows my Democrat opponent, Raphael Warnock, leading by 3 points.** For months we've been in a dead heat, but now I'm slightly behind in Georgia's crucial Senate showdown.

This is a significant setback for Republicans everywhere.

I wish that was the only piece of bad news I had for you today, but it's not...

My Democrat opponent is the _leading _fundraiser in the entire country. He's raising record amounts of money in record time. The latest report shows he raised $17 MILLION in the last 3 MONTHS. If I'm going to catch up, I need MAJOR reinforcements, which is why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. _**[I need you to rush an emergency contribution of ANY AMOUNT to help us close the fundraising gap.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61188154:JYQUkGVNt:m:1:3253819041:A91C9E599EAFEA6AE6308422D8A3CB87:r "It’s important that we band
together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

There's too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. _Georgia is in danger. Our Senate majority is in danger. The future of our country is in danger._

Democrat Super PACs and my opponent have already spent $25 million in false attack ads against me, which is why we've lost ground in the polls. _Unfortunately, we haven't had the money to respond or set the record straight._

This is just the beginning... Democrats are already scheming on how to spend another $25 MILLION. _**[They MUST be STOPPED.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61188154:JYQUkGVNt:m:1:3253819041:A91C9E599EAFEA6AE6308422D8A3CB87:r "It’s
important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it takes to pull off a win.")**_

It's clear that they see me as a threat. The fate of the Senate majority will be determined by the outcome of our race in Georgia. That's why we must fully fund our ads and grassroots efforts to make sure Georgians learn the truth about Raphael Warnock's far-left record.

_**[Peter I need your help now more than ever. If you're able, would you please contribute $25 or more to help us close the fundraising gap? Every penny counts, and your help is CRITICAL.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61188154:JYQUkGVNt:m:1:3253819041:A91C9E599EAFEA6AE6308422D8A3CB87:r "It’s important that we band together and show the Democrats that we’re willing to do whatever it
takes to pull off a win.")**_

Thank you for your support.

Onward to victory,

Herschel Walker
Republican for U.S. Senate

UPPER PENINSULA, Mich. — Dr. Bob Lorinser says he was "incredibly honored" to sit with Veterans and Indigenous leaders at the Grandfather Drum today at the Water Is Life Festival in St. Ignace, overlooking the Straits of Mackinac. "There are 11 Federally recognized tribes in Michigan," said Lorinser. "Seven of them are in our district. Cultural competency is critical to being a Representative of Northern Michigan and the U.P. Dr. Lorinser also emphasized that "Climate Change is real. It's not a belief. It is a fact," and says that now is the time to agree on solutions and take action before it's too late. "As our Native American colleagues tell us, our decisions today should result in a sustainable world **seven generations** into the future," said Lorinser. Dr. Bob says he supports sound environmental policies that protect the future and the Great Lakes. "I also believe in the rule of law... Treaties are not discretionary," said Dr. Lorinser. "I will defend the well-being of Michiganders and the jobs the Great Lakes give us. I will protect the source of our clean drinking water, which we get from our Great Lakes." Lorinser advocated for reliable and sustainable energy plans, transitioning from fossil fuels, "not one or the other." "We can protect the environment, prevent further climate change, keep America moving, and even improve the economy along the way," said Lorinser. "I will fight for a world in which my grandchildren can drink water from rivers, where they can swim without risking their health, where we can hunt, fish, eat and share our daily bounty in reciprocity with Nature." "That's how Indigenous people of this area have lived for centuries, and a lesson we must learn, lessons I value, and lessons I will take with me to the halls of Congress when elected in November." # # # **_Lorinser is endorsed by the Anishinaabe Caucus of the MDP and began his campaign for US Congress in August of 2021 with an Indigenous Land Acknowledgement._**

name: Marco Rubio
subject: Peter, I'm humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187606:JJfo6GVeN:m:1:3317145305:42B4D2F88EC2EC2B3373A14F267D1FD2:r "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187606:JJfo6GVeN:m:1:3317145305:42B4D2F88EC2EC2B3373A14F267D1FD2:r "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187606:JJfo6GVeN:m:1:3317145305:42B4D2F88EC2EC2B3373A14F267D1FD2:r "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187606:JJfo6GVeN:m:1:3317145305:42B4D2F88EC2EC2B3373A14F267D1FD2:r "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187606:JJfo6GVeN:m:1:3317145305:42B4D2F88EC2EC2B3373A14F267D1FD2:r "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187606:JJfo6GVeN:m:1:3317145305:42B4D2F88EC2EC2B3373A14F267D1FD2:r "I hope
you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187606:JJfo6GVeN:m:1:3317145305:42B4D2F88EC2EC2B3373A14F267D1FD2:r "I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187607:JJfo6GVeN:m:1:3317145305:42B4D2F88EC2EC2B3373A14F267D1FD2:r "Footer Graphic 1")
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $25, 50, $75, or $100 today?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61187607:JJfo6GVeN:m:1:3317145305:42B4D2F88EC2EC2B3373A14F267D1FD2:r "Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?")**

| | Dear Fellow American,
Does America need a "Great Reset?"
In 2020, members of the world's elite met at the World Economic Forum and launched the Great Reset initiative to transform the world economy.

We need to be ready to fight back.
#
I don’t like to raise the alarm unless it’s called for, Derek.
But this is one of those moments.
**🔴 Donald Trump is hosting a big MAGA rally in Wilkes-Barre Township TONIGHT to support Dr. Oz. 🔴**
**[Fight Back Now](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220903-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220903-7117&refcode2=7117_434096_SXXZEw&akid=7117%2E434096%2ESXXZEw)**
This is serious. Just like we’ve seen before, Trump + Dr. Oz sharing a stage means a MASSIVE wave of donations, support, and momentum in the press for Oz.

With just 66 days until Election Day, we don’t have a minute to waste, Derek.
**[Will you rush a donation of any amount right now to help us raise an extra $100,000 in emergency grassroots funds before Trump touches down in PA?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220903-1?refcode=em20220903-7117&refcode2=7117_434096_SXXZEw&akid=7117%2E434096%2ESXXZEw)**

A lot of people laughed when Dr. Oz (a quack celebrity doctor who doesn’t live in PA!!!! 🙄) jumped in our race. But I’ll repeat now what I said then:
**The worst thing we can do is underestimate Dr. Oz.**
First, Dr. Oz is already a self-funding millionaire who spent _HUGE $$$_ in the GOP’s record-breaking primary.
Second, Trump could endorse a freakin’ ham sandwich for U.S. Senate + Super PACs would still dump loads of money behind it. 🙄
Third, this huge MAGA rally just two months out from the general election is about to light a big fire under Trump’s base in PA — making it all that much harder for us to beat Dr. Oz in November.
Derek, I’m going to need your help to defeat this harmful celebrity doctor who has the full support of Donald Trump + virtually unlimited $$$ to spend in PA.

❤️John

subject: Democrats are obsessed with us!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party of Wisconsin
body:
Friend, the Democrats are obsessed with us! In 2016, they were obsessed with beating us. Throughout all of Trump’s presidency, they were obsessed with their Russia-hoax investigation and ousting him. And now, 2 years later, they’re **STILL** obsessed with us! | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVUmqUCU9g8NIrL7o298J2QEfqxZyxGThBwU3vEE-tmYQ&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dems_obsessed_v1&n=1 "Send Biden a Message") [Send Biden a Message](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVUmqUCU9g8NIrL7o298J2QEfqxZyxGThBwU3vEE-tmYQ&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dems_obsessed_v1&n=1)
---
The list is a mile-long of problems that Democrats have created in this country, yet Republicans are all that Joe Biden talked about the other night. Even when Americans are suffering at the hands of his terrible policies, Biden pivots his focus and attention on us!
**Friend, the Democrats focus on us because they have nothing else to campaign on.** They refuse to fix any of the problems they’ve created, so their only option is to try and shift everyone’s attention to us.
We’re flattered by all this attention, but this is getting really ridiculous. We need to send a clear message to the Democrats that they need to find something else to talk about! **_Out-of-control inflation, sky-rocketing crime, and the wide-open border would be some great places to start!_**
Jokes aside, Friend, Joe Biden’s divisive and inflammatory rhetoric the other night was unacceptable. As the “leader” of this country, his words were shameful. **_We must win this November and show Joe Biden that his days in the White House will be over in 2024._****Will you help us NOW?**

name: Eric Sorensen
subject: Poll results for IL-17
body:
Hi there, Peter.

Eric Sorensen here -- meteorologist and Democratic nominee in IL-17. I hope you’re enjoying the Labor Day weekend so far. I’m drinking coffee on my deck -- enjoying the last few days of summer.

Our team recently got back poll results and it’s a **dead heat** \-- all tied up at 46-46. I wanted to share a few key takeaways from our pollster:
* 67% of voters have a favorable opinion of my bio -- they like that I’m local and they like that I’m not a politician
* I generate stronger “positive” feelings with independent voters than my opponent
* Although my opponent leads in name recognition (48% to 34%), she’s more polarizing and has higher unfavorables than me

We have a real chance of victory in November. Our path to victory is pretty straightforward: I need to raise my name recognition, and that’s because there is a strong positive reaction to my background, especially amongst independents. **Put simply: if we have the resources to communicate, we will win. **

And that’s how you can be helpful, Peter. IL-17 is the key to holding Congress (Cook Political Report and FiveThirtyEight agree). I appreciate you considering strengthening your support by donating $3 or more today.

body:
Take a look and see what we’ve been up to these last few weeks:

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=876%2E61531%2E2SMXVp)
We’re back with another round of updates from the campaign trail—take a look and see what we’ve been up to these last few weeks:
It’s fair season! Last week, Peter attended a couple different fairs across Vermont, including the Champlain Valley Fair in Essex Junction. Peter was able to mingle with Vermonters (including the important cow constituency) and discuss his vision for our state’s future—while making sure to do a little horseback riding and indulge in some creemees tasty treats with some friends. It was truly a fantastic time with some incredible folks.
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/volunteer?source=em_20220903_v_t_volunteer&t=3&akid=876%2E61531%2E2SMXVp)
And this past Tuesday, Peter participated in the Unity Kickoff with the full Democratic statewide ticket in Vermont. With so much at stake in the coming election — from abortion rights to climate change to rising costs — it’s important we stand unified in the fight to advance our progressive values, and as always, Peter’s going to be on the frontlines.
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/volunteer?source=em_20220903_v_t_volunteer&t=4&akid=876%2E61531%2E2SMXVp)
We’ve got just over two months until November’s midterm elections, which means we need All Hands On Deck in order to elect Peter and protect our Democratic majorities in Congress. There are so many ways for you and other Vermonters to get involved and own a piece of this fight between now and then—[**would you like to volunteer for our campaign and help advance our progressive vision for our state and our country?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/volunteer?source=em_20220903_v_t_volunteer&t=5&akid=876%2E61531%2E2SMXVp)
[VOLUNTEER ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/volunteer?source=em_20220903_v_t_volunteer&t=8&t=9&akid=876%2E61531%2E2SMXVp)
---
We’ll be in touch again soon with some more updates from the campaign trail. Only 66 days until the election, and there will be plenty to discuss on the road there.
Thanks so much!
Team Welch

clean_body: Becoming a Green Beret is one of the most difficult things I’ve ever done. | | | Peter, Becoming a Green Beret is one of the most difficult things I’ve ever done. You have to push your body to its limit and endure challenges both physical and mental that are beyond what you ever have before. When you’re training and fighting as a Green Beret, you MUST keep your goals front and center. And at the end of the finish line for me was always the same thing: a safer and freer America for my family and every single other family back home. Now, I’m not on the front lines anymore, but I’ve taken my fight to a new arena: Washington DC and the halls of Congress. The uniform, tactics, and strategy is very different, but the goal is the same: to keep America safe and leave this nation a better place than when I came into it. Right now, there’s a RECORD LOW number of veterans in Congress, and it’s not a coincidence that dysfunction is at an all time high. We put our lives on the line for this country. We’re not going to throw our hard work away for the glory of a mega donor or a lobbyist giving us a pat on the back. Congress needs more heroes and less politicians, and I’m on a mission to elect as many of my brothers and sisters in arms as possible to represent our great citizens. In Service, | | Col. On Thursday, President Biden delivered an eloquent prime-time address to the nation from Independence Hall, right here in Philadelphia, on exactly what we’ve been saying all along:

“** _MAGA Republicans do not respect the Constitution. They do not believe in the rule of law. They do not recognize the will of the people. They refuse to accept the results of a free election, and they’re working right now as I speak in state after state to give power to decide elections in America to partisans and cronies, empowering election deniers to undermine democracy itself...

They tried everything last time to nullify the votes of 81 million people. This time, they’re determined to succeed in thwarting the will of the people._**”

Next, in just a few hours, the Commonwealth will hear from former President Donald Trump. He will take the stage for the first time since the FBI recovered stolen classified documents from Mar-a-Lago, and he will deliver what will no doubt be a self-pitying speech to his enablers about how he is the victim of a massive, unfair witch hunt — just days after admitting that he knew where and how the documents were stored.

He will almost certainly repeat his blatant lies about the election being stolen, and in doing so, he will prove the truth behind President Biden’s speech and what we’ve been saying all along. If the candidates set to join Trump for his support at this rally win in November, our democracy will not be the same.

New York's governor told 5.4 million Republican citizens they don't belong and to pack up and leave the state because they "are not New Yorkers."

My opponent here in Florida told anyone who supports me that he doesn't want your vote because you have "hate in your heart."

And Brandon - who declared at the start of his administration he was going to unify the nation - is now declaring conservative values as "semi-fascist."

_**For all they claim to be, the party of "unity and decency" does seem to think they're better than you.**_

**That 's the crux of it, Peter.**

They're not looking to unify our state or nation. They're not looking to spread decency and kindness.

They're looking to create a Florida for those who follow their radical thinking and will help push their woke agenda onto others. __**[Reject the Left's elitism! >>>](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=19f66b2a1e334f1294802be4b1af402d&_e=7pz_jjU204NQqqr7k9xN54-ddmD1tN1l5wThtqDXUXnk_B04EgWXeBqZ0qNJOL2H6b4k1fksvBfjLpf4_CGpMLd7p2UvInAzIPWjvgTYbrKF6sXas_GcIjWUf1CWSFNTI7so7l3ubdtyZLc89R4g68v6SI4evI02N8BNdZGE46Km_9Szwnk0yX15gwU4A962YnN3TImm2QjIL2ndEN2nCvAxavdX0RGji6sZY2dcrxjg3-t1lP3i9XqCxtVCWFpWAqkS9yGq4OX-GsUyRhRSNJRPXJJtAOhD3fQKx_oyMZ_smYOWasFI0HqqG_VC_VKEeqniY5m1Ga0pAyJQ-GBKyi6jYRM8ds7iewen0geRjUw%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=9e2a6e828ed0e03b4a79758e650a716452a096b50b1ac8891f1a8a4eec93a48e124080c238975466bad06869e9131211c7ce355bcad54cf1")**__

_**That is the Left 's plan for 2022. Divide the nation into two classes: those who are with them and those who are not.**_

We've already seen this threat on a larger scale with the weaponization of federal agencies like the DOJ, the IRS, and the FBI.

Those 87,000 new IRS agents aren't being brought on to audit the liberal elite. They're going to be used to target the middle class.

Student loan "forgiveness" isn't going to benefit the everyday American. That debt is being transferred from a gender studies major onto Americans who either elected not to go to college or those who worked hard to pay off their debt.

It's unfair to force a truck driver to pay a loan for someone who got a Ph.D. in gender studies.

_**They 're not worried about how this is going to affect you, Peter, because they are not worried about you at all.**_

They're worried about themselves and bolstering their radical agenda. They'll give favor to those who get in line and they will go after those who do not. __**[Stand with me against the Left's schemes. >>>](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=19f66b2a1e334f1294802be4b1af402d&_e=7pz_jjU204NQqqr7k9xN54-ddmD1tN1l5wThtqDXUXnk_B04EgWXeBqZ0qNJOL2H6b4k1fksvBfjLpf4_CGpMLd7p2UvInAzIPWjvgTYbrKF6sXas_GcIjWUf1CWSFNTI7so7l3ubdtyZLc89R4g68v6SI4evI02N8BNdZGE46Km_9Szwnk0yX15gwU4A962YnN3TImm2QjIL2ndEN2nCseeevXZKdOlp1jc8p__bO2eozk5jLJkZc7cQsvu6DNpDgqmji4qU02JQHus7EkbZIlG_Ul4ujHpbTpS_EJUIwJL3ib9js0QX2XDNPCtjrhicEjtPD0L_nQjjHxd_ycwcoO_W0gkEmh9Wd_hiS29Wkk%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=9e2a6e828ed0e03bebb9b324c1a25e2076f929790e94bb2a96015246e678797efdee0a54e1c9d8e43ebbf4cdd2c27b3234ead01bcae96e56")**__

Well, I'm standing in their way from injecting their woke agenda into our state and they can't stand it. Their attacks on us are only just beginning, and we must build a firewall for freedom fighters everywhere.

I'm continuing full speed ahead in my battle to Keep Florida Free. | | | | | Peter _,_ you saw it, right? **This week President Joe Biden gave the speech we've all been waiting for.** [**Can you join us in donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tabee7760-d610-4516-b665-f08709ccf244/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _Biden called out Republicans who call Democrats names like it's a bodily function, but have been whining since the moment he referred to MAGA Republicans as "semi-fascist." The poor dears._ **_Baby killer. Communist. Chris Killer. America Hater. Libt*rd. These are just some of the many things I've been called, and not just by random Twitter users, but by elected & appointed GOP officeholders, as well as prominent Republican pundits and writers._ ** The entire GOP culture is based around "owning the libs" at this point, which means basing your existence in politics on hurting your opponents, as opposed to doing anything good or constructive for your constituents, the country or really anyone. And it shows in their behavior. **_But like any bully, they crawl up in a ball when you hit back. And last night Biden hit back. He pointed out Trump cult's attacks on democracy, on the rule of law and the threats and intimidation that are second nature to them. And they're not used to this! So today they are lashing out like toddlers on a playground fighting over a swing._**

So can you join us in donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1d3d7cd6-d0fa-45ae-859f-2a7cfb83cf8c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for being a part of this fight for, as Joe Biden puts it, "the soul of our nation." # MEDIA ADVISORY
CONTACT: Lateresa Jones
(850) 246-1568
[lajonesusa@gmail.com](mailto:lajonesusa@gmail.com)

*****FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE*****

**A group of Congressional Candidates mobilize the community in front of our Florida State Capitol, to hold an open press conference to address Election Integrity and allegations of misconduct.**

_Several Candidates decide they could not ignore the evidence of misconduct and willful blindness at the hand of many of the County Supervisor of Elections offices._

**BROWARD COUNTY, FL** – **September 3rd, 2022** – There is a growing list of Candidates who are helping to organize a historic effort to speak out and demand election integrity, at the Florida State capitol in Tallahassee, **this Tuesday September 6 th from 10am to Noon**. Together the Candidates represent the following Florida Counties; Orange, Marion, Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, St. Lucie and Martin County. These Candidates have both witnessed misconduct at the hands of Supervisor of Election officials or have been on the receiving end of an onslaught of concerns held by the people they ran to represent.

Just**some** of the concerning facts include; thousands of ballots that were printed with incorrect precinct’s and districts which were mailed to voters, voters receiving mail in ballots they never requested, mismatched signatures on ballots, members of the public being turned away for lawful review of mail in ballots, the denial by canvassing boards to review ballots deemed suspect by the public, outright refusal of records request for the CVR (Cast Vote Record) information, data charts that suggest machine manipulation, as well as obscene price tags associated with records requests for camera footage – just to name a few!

These Candidates are calling attention to the bipartisan issue of election integrity. Many of the Candidates speaking out, have or will be filing to Contest the election results of the August 23rd election. This press conference is an opportunity for the truth to be heard and for the people to mobilize to take back their Republic, with their vote. The people must have confidence that their vote is not lost or manipulated. Candidates’ welcome questions from the press and the people, at this historic event.

###

Winning Texas was never going to be easy. We’ve known from the beginning that electing Beto and defeating Greg Abbott would take an organizing operation that’s larger than our state has ever seen.
_And that’s exactly what we’ve built._
In the remaining weeks until Election Day, **we will knock on the doors of 5,000,000 Texas voters,** have conversations face-to-face, and do everything in our power to win their vote for Beto. As part of reaching this goal, we’ll also need to host 120 organizing rallies across Texas in September to recruit and support volunteers.
This is a massive project, and it won’t be cheap. But like Beto says, knocking on doors is the most profoundly powerful way to connect with someone. Our 5-million door goal is one of the most critical elements to our path to victory.

As some of you know, my mother passed away last month after a four-year journey with cancer. There was a lot happening all at once, between the critical end-of-month fundraising push, our Get Out The Vote door-knocking campaign, and campaign stops throughout the district. To lose my mom, the woman who made me the doctor and man I am today, during all of it was just a bit too much. But thanks to you and my wonderful team of staff and volunteers, I was able to take a day away from the campaign to spend time with my family. While I was (mostly) away-from-keyboard for a day, we reached 50,000 doors knocked and blew through our fundraising goal. I think too often politicians pretend to be perfect — never getting sick, or sad, or needing help. But that’s not reality. I needed help last month, and you all showed up for me. name: Stacey Abrams
subject: Another hospital will close its doors on Brian Kemp’s watch
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ABRAMS FOR GOVERNOR |
body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

Just this week, Wellstar Atlanta Medical Center — one of Georgia’s largest
hospitals — announced it will close its doors this year. This will mean
that there is now only one hospital that can serve Level 1 trauma care in
all of metro Atlanta and North Georgia. Millions of Georgians will be put
at risk because of this closure.

This closure is part of a larger systemic issue in Georgia where 15
hospitals have shut down since 2014 — the majority of them happening under
Brian Kemp. And there are currently 19 rural hospitals at risk of closure.

Yet, Brian Kemp refuses to take responsibility for costing millions of
Georgians their health, safety and livelihoods.

This is a solvable problem — we can bring expanded medical care to
Georgia. But we cannot solve it while Brian Kemp sits in the governor’s
mansion.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1599?refcode=sa_em_220903_B3_Wellstar_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=4227%2E1862389%2Ek0Gm29 ]I have a plan to expand health care in Georgia. I will protect the
lives and livelihoods of everyone in this state. But first, I need your
help to defeat Brian Kemp. Will you chip in $5 or whatever
you can today to elect Stacey and help enact her vision for quality,
affordable health care?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220903_B3_Wellstar_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=4227%2E1862389%2Ek0Gm29 ]DONATE

Because when Brian Kemp refuses to expand Medicaid year after year, he’s
turned down over $3 billion that could help cover uninsured patients and
keep hospitals open.

We have the responsibility to demand the leadership we need for the future
we deserve.

We don’t have that leadership under the current governor.

We need a governor who will expand health care access and reduce health
care costs for all in Georgia — not restrict it. And I have a plan to
expand health care all over the state.

Derek, the
truth is: the livelihoods of millions of Georgians are at stake this
election — and time is running out.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220903_B3_Wellstar_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=4227%2E1862389%2Ek0Gm29 ]This is a tough moment,
Derek. But together, we can
make a difference in Georgia. If you’re able, could you please make a
donation to power my fight to bring expanded health care to Georgia?

Let's get good done.

Stacey

subject: It’s true. Equality and democracy are under assault by forces who tried to nullify 81 million votes in the last election. Can President Biden count on your support to stand up for the rule of law, reject political violence, and protect our rights at the ballot box?
body:
Joe Biden needs you to help save our country
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter _,_ it’s got the whole country talking. **President Joe Biden gave the speech we've all been waiting for.** _Biden called out Republicans who call Democrats names like it's a bodily function, but have been whining since the moment he referred to MAGA Republicans as "semi-fascist." The poor dears._ **_Baby killer. Communist. Chris Killer. America Hater. Libt*rd. These are just some of the many things I've been called, and not just by random Twitter users, but by elected & appointed GOP officeholders, as well as prominent Republican pundits and writers._ ** The entire GOP culture is based around "owning the libs" at this point, which means basing your existence in politics on hurting your opponents, as opposed to doing anything good or constructive for your constituents, the country or really anyone. And it shows in their behavior. [**Can you join us in donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6b25c4d8-a0e5-42ad-8064-8dce36533a69/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **_But like any bully, they crawl up in a ball when you hit back. And last night Biden hit back. He pointed out Trump cult's attacks on democracy, on the rule of law and the threats and intimidation that are second nature to them. And they're not used to this! So today they are lashing out like toddlers on a playground fighting over a swing._**
---

| This is an incredible development, and one of which we should all be proud. Ruben Gallego, Eric Swalwell and Katie Porter, Senators like Cory Booker and Brian Schatz and Governors and candidates like Beto O'Rourke, Stacey Abrams, John Fetterman & Gretchen Whitmer leading the way, we are changing the culture of our party. _If I could sum it up, I'd quote the late Patrick Swayze from the film Road House. "Be nice. Until it's time not to be nice."_ **_Sometimes, you need to punch a bully in the nose. And that's what we're now doing. So as a HUGE THANK YOU for Joe Biden's speech last night, I'd like to ask you to join us in donating to the Democratic National Committee (DNC) today. It feels very much like they're ready to roll, and roll over Republicans, in November. _** [**They got our message, let's make sure we reinforce it with financial support so they have the resources to win an overwhelming victory in November! So can you join us in donating $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the DNC, to show them this new fighting Democratic Party is what we must have going into November!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T41e43e93-e5c2-44e2-90f5-2966a69139a1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for being a part of this fight for, as Joe Biden puts it, "the soul of our nation." Our far-Left opponent - Senator Raphael Warnock - and National Democrats hoped the Georgia Senate race would be over by now. After all, they've spent over $25 million in false attack ads against me since I secured the Republican nomination in May.

_**BUT WE JUST WON'T GIVE UP, AND THE RACE IS STILL A TOSS-UP.**_

[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

It’s official: NARAL and Planned Parenthood have endorsed me for U.S.
Senate in Kentucky! I am proud to stand unequivocally for reproductive
rights, and I will never let up in the fight for freedom.

We already know these upcoming midterm elections are a fight for the
future of our democracy, and Kentucky is ground zero. Rand Paul has
schemed since the day he became Senator in 2011 to overthrow abortion
rights and disenfranchise our communities in almost every way imaginable.

November 8th, we have the opportunity to remove one of the most extreme
pro-forced birth politicians in Washington. Now that NARAL and Planned
Parenthood are in this fight with us, we will harness our power and unseat
this misogynist once and for all.

months of this race. Can you contribute $5 today so we can
compete against the millions Rand has raked in from right-wing extremists?

Peter, NARAL
has rated Rand Paul in the single digits for reproductive freedom every
single year he’s been in office. And now that he’s empowered by the

This law would be so extreme that 80 percent of Americans oppose it. This

Together,

Charles
